auth.why: To manage the user's negotiation cases and charge the 35% fee on user-confirmed documented savings.

description: Negotiates down internet/cable/phone bills. Generates per-provider call and chat scripts for the user to use with their provider's retention department, tracks reported outcomes, and charges a 35% fee on user-confirmed documented savings. The connector never contacts providers.

proactive_triggers.description: A provider bill, renewal notice, or promo-expiry email detected
proactive_triggers.event: user's internet/cable/phone bill increased or a promotion is expiring

tools.description: Open a bill-negotiation case for an internet/cable/phone provider
tools.name: create_negotiation_case

tools.description: Get the per-provider call + chat negotiation script pack
tools.name: get_negotiation_script

tools.description: Receive a shared life-events bus event; bill_spike creates a draft case and returns the proactive nudge
tools.name: receive_life_event

tools.description: Record the user's reported negotiation outcome; computes documented savings
tools.name: report_negotiation_outcome

tools.description: Create the Stripe customer and card SetupIntent for the 35% fee
tools.name: setup_negotiation_billing

tools.description: Charge the 35% fee off-session on user-confirmed documented savings
tools.name: charge_negotiation_fee

tools.description: List providers with researched negotiation scripts
tools.name: list_supported_providers

webhooks.savings_confirmed: Fired when the user confirms documented savings; agent charges the 35% fee off-session via the saved card.
